_source: Manually curated from https://untappd.com/blog's 'New Badge: X' posts - these are Untappd's own time-limited promotional badges, never in the permanent badges.untappd.com catalog (badge_beer_categories.json/badge_venue_categories.json), so they have to be read and re-catalogued by hand whenever a new one is announced. Checked live 2026-11-09 - entries are ACTIVE-or-UPCOMING as of that date (activeUntil >= today); the previously-catalogued International Stout Day Badge (2026) was pruned this check since its activeUntil (2026-11-08) has now passed, leaving this list empty. Four new 'New Badge'-type posts found this check (Amaro Day, Untappd 16th Anniversary, Scream-Worthy Hard Cider, NC Beer Month Passport + Sweepstakes, all 2026) were each already past their own activeUntil (2026-10-31) by the time this check ran, so none were added here or flagged pending - they're simply moot now, same treatment as the five moot posts noted in the prior check. The 'Untappd Check In Challenge, Season 1' post (already flagged in special_badges_pending_review.json) still only reveals Week 1's criteria ('check in any drink', not computable by this schema); Week 2 (Nov 9-15) is listed as revealed today but its criteria text wasn't present on the post yet at check time - re-check for it on a later pass. New posts whose criteria this schema can't compute (brewery-specific, venue-location, or otherwise ambiguous) are logged in special_badges_pending_review.json instead of guessed here. Re-check the blog periodically (no feed/API for this - it's a real page read each time) and prune entries whose activeUntil has passed, same way this list was built.
